# Data loading

```{r}

string.names <- function(vector){
  for(i in 1:length(names(vector))){
    names(vector)[i] <- paste0("V_", names(vector)[i])
  }
  return(names(vector))
}

```


```{r}
# labels
path <- 'datas'
latent.path <- "datas/latent_test.csv"
labels.path <- "datas/Morpho_test - discrete - 5_5_5_5_5_10.csv"

# latents
path <- 'DATAS/MNIST'
latent <- fread(latent.path, data.table = F, sep = ",", header = TRUE, index = FALSE)
data_disc <- fread(labels.path, data.table = F, sep = ",", header = TRUE, index = FALSE)

names(latent) <- string.names(latent)
# names(data_disc) <- string.names(data_disc)

names(latent)

```

# Exclusion des relations continu → discret
# Entrainement BN

```{r}

disc <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
cont <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

set.seed(42)
blacklist <- expand.grid(from = cont, to = disc)

bn <- hc(
  data,
  score = "bic-cg",
  blacklist = blacklist
)

# bn_fitted <- bn.fit(bn, data, method = "mle-cg") 


```



```{r}

start.time <- Sys.time()

set.seed(42)

arcs.list.boot <- bn.boot(
  data = data, 
  R = 1000, 
  m = 4000, 
  algorithm = "hc",  
  algorithm.args = list(score = "bic-cg", blacklist = blacklist), 
  statistic = arcs)


end.time <- Sys.time()
end.time -start.time

```




```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)

combined_df <- do.call(rbind, arcs.list.boot)
combined_df <- as.data.frame(combined_df)

combined_df <- combined_df %>% group_by_all() %>% count
combined_df$freq <- combined_df$freq/1000
combined_df_kept <- combined_df[combined_df$freq >= 0.9,]

combined_df[combined_df$from %in% names(data_disc),]
combined_df[combined_df$to == "height",]
combined_df_kept

```


```{r}

DAG.path <- "datas/bn_arcs/arcs_bn_boot-R_1k-m_4k.csv"
write.csv(combined_df, DAG.path)

```

```{r}

scale <- c(100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000)
mu <- c()
sigma <- c()
for(s in scale){
  # print(paste(i*1000, logLik(bn.fitted, data[1:(i*1000),]))) 
  log.lik <- c()
  set.seed(42)
  for(j in 1:1000){
    index <- sapply(runif(s, 1, 10000), as.integer)
    
    log.lik <- c(log.lik, logLik(bn.fitted, data[index, ]))  
  }
  mu <- c(mu, mean(log.lik))
  sigma <- c(sigma, sd(log.lik))
}



logLik(bn.fitted, data[1:10000, ])
print(logLik(bn.fitted, data[1:10000, ]))

data[1:10000, ]



```

```{r}

# load BOOTSTRAP
DAG.path <- "datas/bn_arcs/arcs_bn_boot-R_1000-m_2000.csv"
df.arcs <- read.csv(DAG.path, row.names = 1)
df.arcs.robust <- df.arcs[df.arcs$freq > 0.9, ]

# load BOOTSTRAP ARCS in BN
arcs(bn) <- df.arcs.robust[, 1:2]

# TRAIN BN
bn.fitted <- bn.fit(bn, data, method = "mle-cg") 
graphviz.plot(bn.fitted)

```

# 5. Generated Samples

```{r}
set.seed(42)
obs <- gen_sample[1, ]
obs

# (V_24 > obs$V_24 -sen)&(V_24 < obs$V_24 +sen)
cpquery(bn.fitted, event = (thickness == "0"), evidence = (V_24 > obs$V_24 -sen)&(V_24 < obs$V_24 +sen))
#cpdist(bn.fitted, nodes = c("thickness", "area"), evidence = (V_24 > obs$V_24 -sen)&(V_24 < obs$V_24 +sen))
```

```{r}


p_before <- cpquery(bn.fitted, event = (area == "0"), evidence = obs)$prob
p_before

obs[j] <- obs[j] + 0.1  # Incrément test
p_after <- cpquery(bn.fitted, event = (area == "0"), evidence = obs)$prob
abs(p_after - p_before) > 0.05
```
